channel.title: Treasure Coast Today
channel.description: Local news for Martin, St. Lucie and Indian River counties, Florida.

item.title: Four arrested in Martin County after armed robbery of teen and pursuit, deputies say
item.description: Four suspects were arrested in Martin County following an armed robbery of a teenager and a subsequent pursuit, according to deputies.

item.title: Hobe Sound getting first Aldi grocery store at former Winn-Dixie site on July 9
item.description:
Hobe Sound is getting its first Aldi store when the new grocery store opens July 9 at 8867 SE Bridge Road. The location is in the space where Winn-Dixie used to be.

item.title: Peacock House Art Foundation transforms Fort Pierce into artistic destination with global artists
item.description: The Peacock House Art Foundation is transforming Fort Pierce into an artistic destination, preserving the legacy of Jaxson and Mary Crain while connecting local and international artists.

item.title: Serena Williams withdraws from Wimbledon doubles with sister Venus due to knee injury
item.description: Serena Williams withdrew from her Wimbledon doubles match with sister Venus on Saturday due to a right knee injury sustained during her singles return earlier in the week.

item.title: Argentina survives Cape Verde scare with 3-2 extra time World Cup win
item.description: Lionel Messi and defending World Cup champion Argentina beat Cape Verde 3-2 on Friday in South Florida, advancing to the Round of 16 after the tiny island nation challenged them until the final minutes of extra time.

item.title: Trump intervened with FIFA president before Balogun red card suspension lifted
item.description: President Donald Trump called FIFA president Gianni Infantino after Folarin Balogun's red card, asking FIFA to review the decision before the suspension was lifted for Monday's World Cup match against Belgium.

item.title: Four suspects arrested after armed robbery of teen and pursuit in Martin County
item.description: Four people accused in the armed robbery of a teenager were arrested following a pursuit in Martin County, according to deputies.

item.title: Construction Begins on 18-Hole Golf Course at Esplanade at Solaeris in Port St. Lucie
item.description:
